annotation.title_clean: Artificial Intelligence - The consequences of artificial intelligence on the (digital) single market, production, consumption, employment and society (own-initiative opinion)
annotation.title_en: Artificial Intelligence - The consequences of artificial intelligence on the (digital) single market, production, consumption, employment and society (own-initiative opinion)
annotation.summary_en: EESC web page describing its 2017 own-initiative opinion on the societal consequences of AI for the single market, production, consumption, employment and society. It notes AI's potential benefits and risks (labour, safety, privacy, ethics, skills) and calls for a broad approach. The opinion text itself is only linked as downloads.
key_provisions_or_claims: AI offers great potential to improve lives, grow the economy and address health, climate and security challenges.
AI carries risks in labour, safety, privacy, ethics and skills.
A broad approach covering all effects of AI on society is crucial.
Opinion adopted 31 May 2017, rapporteur Catelijne Muller, published in OJ C 288.
